wca_starved.label: WCA dimer, starved cell  (beta=1, h=2)
wca_starved.note: Confirmatory Case IX at the corrected high-precision reference; 16 paired seeds.
wca_starved.ref_label: HP reference v2 (v2 campaign; unsmoothed, nonuniform acquisition)

wca_five_arm.label: WCA dimer, five-arm mechanism test
wca_five_arm.note: Same cell and reference as the flagship. count_balancing is the non-Fisher-Rao reallocation rule: if it tracks mFR, the gain is not FR-specific.
wca_five_arm.ref_label: HP reference v2 (v2 campaign; unsmoothed, nonuniform acquisition)

gateway_left.label: Entropic gateway, init=left  [primary anchor]
gateway_left.note: Constructed establishment-limited regime; 32 preregistered fresh seeds. FR ramps in over the first 10 % of the run rather than switching on.

gateway_one_right.label: Entropic gateway, init=one_right  [mechanism control]
gateway_one_right.note: Constructed establishment-limited regime; 32 preregistered fresh seeds. FR ramps in over the first 10 % of the run rather than switching on.

eb_beta2.label: Entropic bottleneck, beta=2
eb_beta2.note: One model family, one estimator, one plotting convention; only beta changes.

eb_beta4.label: Entropic bottleneck, beta=4
eb_beta4.note: One model family, one estimator, one plotting convention; only beta changes.

eb_beta8.label: Entropic bottleneck, beta=8
eb_beta8.note: One model family, one estimator, one plotting convention; only beta changes.

eb_beta12.label: Entropic bottleneck, beta=12
eb_beta12.note: One model family, one estimator, one plotting convention; only beta changes.

toy2d.label: 2-D metastability toy  (xi = x)
toy2d.note: SELECTION CAVEAT: each FR arm was tuned over 36 configurations, ABF over 1. The unsuffixed FR arm is the SELECTED config; '__cfgN' arms are the other 35. A best-of-36 vs best-of-1 contrast is not an unbiased comparison.

butane_phi1.label: Butane, xi = phi1
butane_phi1.note: ABF is already sufficient here; the FR mechanism nearly switches itself off.

pentane_phi1.label: Pentane, xi = phi1
pentane_phi1.note: Gentle mFR is equivalent; the 'active' arm raises the FR rate and harms a hidden conditional.

pentane_r15.label: Pentane, xi = R15 distance
pentane_r15.note: The only genuinely starved cell in the campaign -- and mFR still fails, oracle included: reallocation converts a support deficit into a diversity deficit.

alanine.label: Alanine dipeptide, xi = (phi, psi)  [vacuum]
alanine.note: ORACLE mFR at three FR rates. The atomistic neutrality control: the mechanism fires, and the free-energy error does not move.

excluded.methane_water: ABF-sufficient at the preregistered screen; no mFR arm was ever licensed.
excluded.nacl_water: ABF-only screen found no persistent population deficit; protocol did not license mFR.
excluded.valine: ABF reaches and establishes every region before mFR could act; stopped at the ABF-only gate.
excluded.deca_alanine: ABF baseline invalid (retracted screen); a contrast against it would be meaningless.
excluded.c60_water: Suspended before any production data; zero-data state preserved.
excluded.wca_production_v1: Scored against the SUPERSEDED reference and stores no profile time series, so it can be neither reused nor rescored. Superseded by wca_caseix_hp.
